info.srcrow: GOES-West: bands 2 and 13 of NOAA’s ABI L2 CMIP, its archive on AWS; GOES-East: bands 2 and 13 of NOAA’s ABI L2 CMIP, its archive on AWS; Himawari-9: bands 3 and 13 of JAXA’s gridded Himawari L1 (P-Tree), calibrated by JAXA/JMA; Meteosat-9: SEVIRI 0.6 and 10.8 µm, EUMETSAT’s Level 1.5 from the Data Store; MTG-I1: FCI 0.6 and 10.5 µm, EUMETSAT’s Level 1c from the Data Store — on 12 Sept.
